visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue knit cardigan over a white collared shirt, sits in a living room. She holds a black nylon Prada bag with a silver chain in front of her. The background features a grey sofa and white plush toys. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where she holds up a lipstick tube, then switches to a light blue circular cushion foundation compact. She holds the compact near her face, smiling and gesturing with her hands. (3) A digital graphic phase shows several light blue Prada cushion compacts floating on a solid light blue background, with the central one being much larger and showing the silver triangular logo. (4) The woman is back on screen, applying the cushion foundation to her wrist using a small puff. She then dabs the puff onto her cheek while looking into the mirror of the compact. (5) A split-screen or sequential cut shows a side-view of her face labeled 'Before' and 'After', showing a more even skin tone. (6) She interacts with a large white dog on the sofa, petting and kissing it to demonstrate the foundation's durability. (7) Rapid cuts show her in various environments: a city skyline, a beach at sunset, and a snowy landscape, while she continues to pose and look at her reflection. (8) She holds up her smartphone showing a lock screen at 12:55, then acts out a phone call and shows the clean screen to indicate no makeup transfer. (9) She puts the compact back into her black Prada bag on a table. (10) The video ends with a white screen displaying the brand logo and product information in black and gold-toned text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 synthetic beat and shimmering synth pads. A cheerful female voice introduces the video with high arousal and a friendly tone. (2) A sharp 'Pop' SFX triggers as visual elements appear, followed by a 'Whoosh' transition as the scene shifts to the product. The music maintains a constant energy level. (3) A clean 'Ding' sound effect is heard as the foundation compact is presented, synchronized with on-screen variety text. The speaker's pitch is slightly elevated to convey excitement. (4) A series of 'Sparkle' and 'Digital UI' chirps are layered over the music during the application demonstration, emphasizing specific product features mentioned in the narration. (5) As the background visuals rapidly change, multiple 'Whoosh' sounds create a sense of movement. The background music remains the dominant melodic layer, with vocals mixed clearly in the center. (6) A final soft 'Ding' SFX marks the closing logo sequence, with the music fading out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase -> Evidence/Demonstration -> Brand Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for the Prada Beauty 'Baby Blue' cushion foundation. It utilizes a fast-paced, energetic editing style and cheerful narration to highlight the product's aesthetic appeal, skin coverage, durability (against pet interaction and long-wear travel), and non-transfer properties.
